scientific_integrity: The density and exact dyadic profile have a symbolic proof. Finite prefix scans corroborate the theorem but do not prove an infinite assertion. No independent external mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to binary Rudin–Shapiro prefixes, not arbitrary shifted factors or all morphic words; the all-length discrepancy bound need not be optimal. An earlier unindexed equivalent calculation cannot be excluded by searchable records.
title: Exact scattered-subsequence universality of Rudin–Shapiro prefixes
